name: Lu Thai Textile Co., Ltd.
summary: Lu Thai Textile Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, specializes in the manufacturing and global distribution of textile products, particularly yarn-dyed and dyed fabrics intended for shirts and various other garments. Their comprehensive product line includes raw materials such as combed cotton and blended yarns, alongside a diverse array of yarns and finished fabrics made from cotton, synthetic fibers, silk, wool, and other materials. The company also produces finished shirts and offers an extensive selection of specialized dyed fabrics, including non-iron, white, multi-component, digital printing, stretch, pant, and general garment fabrics. These offerings are marketed under their distinct brands: LUTHAI, LT-GRFF, BESSSHIRT, and CAVAD. Lu Thai Textile maintains a substantial international presence, conducting operations across Mainland China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, the broader Southeast Asian region, Europe, the United States, and other global markets. Founded in 1993, the firm is headquartered in Zibo, located in the People's Republic of China.
